description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Ursula)] and [Monk Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Ursula)
description.text: Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 2 additional times, 5%/10%/15%/20% additional critical damage for equipped Monk abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Monk abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Ursula)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Ursula)
description.text: Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Monk abilities, grants [100% Critical (15s)]/[100% Critical (15s)] and [Critical Damage +50% 2] to all allies after using Monk abilities if 0-3/4+ FF4 allies are alive, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2] to self after using Monk abilities if 5 FF4 allies are alive

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 2
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
